text.tspan: derived-credit
Handler publishes native reason or transfers failure
custody before last old-route access; count zero is
not work closure
entry
Permanent trampoline uses one tagged lock-free
admission/refcount CAS before dereferencing route or
endpoint; paused pre-CAS handler is uncounted but
harmless
revoke
Close same atomic admission gate first; late
handlers cannot acquire old generation; do not
confuse disposition update with grace completion
storage-commit
Retire old route/native endpoint only after
admission closed, active pins zero, work/fault debt
zero and old-roster receipt; stable shell outlives
VM
masks
Track actual calling-thread mask and normalized
results; thread roster/birth fence needed for any
all-thread claim; masking is not route reclamation
authority
failure
Unknown mask/disposition/wake result retains
coordinator and delivery custody; no false drain
acknowledgement or blocking of GC roles
participant
Drain while old roster/root/finite-wait services
remain alive; caller POSIX mask is distinct from
Scheme sync-op service mask
mailbox
Denied or ambiguous late signal goes to process-
lifetime native mailbox, not stale VM pointer or
automatic next-generation replay; preserve reason
policy

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: retirement
A selected pre-CAS handler may be denied after route
retirement; every legacy bypass must first migrate
latency
Progress requires handler termination, scheduler/OS
fairness and prior wake protocol; no measured speedup
ownership
O(R+H+T) route/active-handler/thread-policy metadata;
process shell cannot be reclaimed by individual VM
language
Zig cannot remove signal ABI, root lifetime, grace or
semantic ownership proofs; no mandatory incremental
benefit established
